Welcome to GTO Data Change Detection System
=========================================

.. toctree::
   :maxdepth: 2
   :caption: Contents:

   core/readme

Overview
--------

The GTO Data Change Detection System helps maintain data integrity by automatically detecting and documenting changes in your data.

Key Features
-----------

* Automatic data change detection
* Comprehensive change reporting
* Historical state tracking
* Beautiful documentation generation

Getting Started
--------------

To get started with the system, see the :doc:`core/readme` file.

Module Documentation
------------------

The system is organized into three main components:

* :doc:`core/modules` - Core system functionality
* :doc:`tracking/modules` - Data tracking and monitoring
* :doc:`reporting/modules` - Change reporting and analysis
